pages.text: Craft any $(item)Primal$() tool from planks and a vanilla wooden tool. Each tool levels through use.$(br2)At level 10, 20, 30… tier-upgrade with $(l:progression/gems)gems$() ($(#55FF55)Shift+Right-click$()).$(br2)Tools reach $(#55FF55)Tier 9$(). Bow caps at Tier 4 (level 50).

Armor pieces level independently — same tier system but T1 uses $(item)8 Chains$() instead of cobblestone.$(br2)Bind traits once you have open slots. See $(l:intro/tiers)Tiers & Slots$() and $(l:traits/smithing_table)Trait Smithing$().
